{{Top|ca|leg}}
{{Quote|Another script, Massassi, was in use by the warrior class of the Sith species, and appears etched on temple walls on Yavin 4; xenographologists have since confirmed that the Massassi alphabet has ties to the simplified component of High Sith writing.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan, "The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic"|<ref name="Written">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>}}
A '''xenographologist''' was a specialist that [[Scientist/Legends|studied]] [[Writing/Legends|writing systems]] of the cultures of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. At some point by [[38 ABY]], xenographologists had confirmed that the [[Massassi (alphabet)|alphabet]] used by<ref name="Written" /> the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]], the [[Massassi (language)|Massassi]]-[[Language/Legends|speaking]]<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> warrior class of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was connected to the simplified component of the [[High Sith]] writing system. That fact was subsequently noted by the [[Xenolinguist/Legends|xenolinguist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]] in<ref name="Written" /> her<ref name="TT">{{WEGCite|story=Erasing All Traces|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> 38 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]] publication "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]."<ref name="Written" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xenographologists were introduced in the article "[[The Written Word]]," which was authored by [[John Hazlett]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] on [[March 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="Written" /> The word "xenographologist" is a combination of the prefix "xeno-," meaning alien,<ref name="Xeno">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dictionary.com/browse/xeno-|text=Xeno- Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Dictionary.com|Dictionary.com, LLC]]|quote=a combining form meaning "alien," "strange," "guest," used in the formation of compound words|archivedate=20220629044904}}</ref> and "graphologist," denoting either someone who practices the [[Wikipedia:Graphology|study]] of handwriting or a researcher who [[Wikipedia:Graphemics|studies]] writing systems.<ref name="Graphology">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dictionary.com/browse/graphology|text=Graphology Definition & Meaning|work=[[Wikipedia:Dictionary.com|Dictionary.com, LLC]]|quote=1. the study of handwriting, especially when regarded as an expression of the writer's character, personality, abilities, etc.<br />2. ''Linguistics''. the study of systems of writing; grammatology|archivedate=20210614155328}}</ref>
